description: I am a solo participant from Dhaka, Bangladesh. I love space and storytelling. My project is for the challenge Abandoned but not Forgotten. I will tell fun stories about NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars for school kids. I will complete this project solo.
summary:
The Planet That Called Back

Earth has become extremely polluted and humans cannot live here anymore. The Government and NASA select 100 people from around the world to find a new planet for humanity. Adrien, a 17-year-old boy, is one of them. After saying goodbye to his family, Adrien joins the spacecraft. He is placed in a 5-member team - Anya, Troy, Joe, Brent and Adrien - led by Dr. Jean Dupont. Their mission is to discover a new planet.After many days of failed research, Adrien discovers a strange planet that looks almost like Earth. They try to send a signal to it. The next morning, they receive two signals back from the planet. They decode one signal. It says only one word: "HELLO".The team travels closer to the planet to research it. But suddenly their monitors start glitching. They lose all contact with Earth and headquarters. Their aircraft gets lost in the galaxy. They never find Earth again, and they never reach the planet that said Hello.
details:
The Planet That Called Back

The Problem: When a spacecraft goes far into deep space, it can lose contact with Earth. Astronauts face signal loss, navigation failure, and extreme isolation. Many students do not understand how difficult and scary this situation can be. Our Solution: "The Planet That Called Back" is a visual, story-based interactive experience that takes the user on a space mission. The story starts with a normal mission. Suddenly, the monitors start glitching, the signals become weak, and the spacecraft loses contact with Earth. The team is now lost in the galaxy. Through 7 slides, we show the journey step-by-step: the launch, the glitch, the loss of contact, the fear and confusion, and finally, the hope to find a way back home. How It Works: 1. The user opens the story presentation. 2. Each slide shows a new stage of the mission with visuals and simple text. 3. The user learns about real space problems like communication delay, signal loss, and navigation in deep space. 4. The story ends with a message of teamwork, courage, and never giving up. Tools Used: We used Canva for design and storytelling. We used NASA images and information about deep space communication and astronaut missions for inspiration. Our Goal: Our goal is to make space science easy, emotional, and interesting for students and young learners. We want to inspire the next generation to learn about space, NASA missions, and how technology helps astronauts stay connected and safe. Future Plan: In the future, we want to make this story into a full interactive website and game where users can make decisions to fix the signal and bring the spacecraft back to Earth.
